title.zh: 重新划拨第1411号共和国法第二编f段莱特省第80页第II组第（27）目（p）项所拨2000比索中未支用的1678比索23分余额的法案
title.en: An Act Reappropriating the Sum of One Thousand Six Hundred Seventy-Eight Pesos and Twenty-Three Centavos Which is the Unexpended Balance of Two Thousand Pesos Appropriated Under Item (p), Page 80 Group II, Subparagraph (27), for the Province of Leyte, Paragraph f, Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven

text.en:
The sum of one thousand six hundred seventy-eight pesos and twenty-three centavos which is the unexpended balance of two thousand pesos appropriated under item (p), page 80, group II, subparagraph f, Section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, to wit:
"(p) Apid Artesian well, Inopacan Construction ₱2,000.00" is hereby reappropriated for the construction of water tank in Apid, Inopacan, Province of Leyte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
